sources.title: GitHub - WuJunde/PromptUNet: Interactive Medical Image Segmentation
sources.snippet: OnePrompt Model produces high quality organ/tissue masks on unseen tasks through one unser-given prompted template. It has strong zero-shot performance on a variety of medical image segmentation tasks, including CT, MRI, ultrasound, fundus, and dermoscopic images. Check our Paper for details.
